educationalGoal: This course will provide students with knowledge of genetic engineering. This course has two aims. The first is to teach students the basics of genetic engineering. The second is to introduce applications of genetic engineering.
advice:
This course will include the following topics:

1) Basics of genetic engineering

2) Application of genetic engineering
    DNA microarray
    Next-generation sequencer
    Gene editing

              This course will provide students with knowledge of genetic engineering. This course has two aims. The first is to teach students the basics of genetic engineering. The second is to introduce applications of genetic engineering.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course will include the following topics:

1) Basics of genetic engineering
    Enzymes (restriction enzymes, DNA ligase, etc.)
    Cloning vectors (plasmid vectors, phage vectors, etc.)
    Gene cloning (PCR, genome cloning, cDNA cloning)
    Transformation
    Gene analysis (hybridization analysis, blotting analyses)

2) Application of genetic engineering
    DNA microarray
    Next-generation sequencer
    Gene editing

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbooks：Genetic Engineering 2nd ed.
Reference books：Lewin’s Genes XLL
Reserved books：Unspecified

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This course is an extension of the topics students learn in the “Basic Biology”, “Bioengineering” and “Molecular Biology” courses. Knowledge of DNA and RNA is required.
